Want help quitting porn in 90 days? Work with me and we’ll resolve the root cause: https://www.stopporn.info Free guide to identify and resolve the root cause of your porn use: https://urges.stopporn.info/download My Podcast: 200+ episodes with tools to quit porn and rebuild your relationship: https://open.spotify.com/show/32uM9Y9... Most men think marriage will fix the porn problem. Then they get married and discover it didn't. This video explains exactly why — and gives you the 5-step plan that actually works for married men. Porn was never a sex problem. It's a coping mechanism. And until you understand what's actually driving it, no amount of willpower or accountability will get you free. In this video I walk through the exact 5-step plan I use with married men in my coaching program — so you can quit porn for good and rebuild trust with your wife at the same time. In this video you'll learn: • Why marriage can't fix this — and what's really going on underneath • The one question to ask yourself the next time an urge shows up • Why matching the right tool to the right root cause is everything • How to involve your wife in a way that actually helps instead of hurting • What to give her instead of promises — so trust can finally start coming back • Why a slip after weeks of progress doesn't mean you're back to zero Most porn addiction recovery advice tells you to fight the urge. This plan resolves what's creating it — one layer at a time — until your brain stops needing the escape in the first place. Sam Tielemans is a licensed marriage and family therapist (LMFT) with 15+ years of experience helping men quit porn for good. …...more
